## Highlights

- Import direct Claude Code JSONL session history into native Codex tasks with `claude plan` and `claude import --yes`.
- Use the native Codex App Server external-agent migration protocol.
- Discover all direct sessions with exact-hash and legacy-history deduplication.
- Keep Claude sources read-only and add locked replanning, a Codex Desktop guard, private recovery snapshots, and post-import ledger verification.

## Validation

- GitHub Actions passed on Python 3.11, 3.12, and 3.13.
- 138 tests, `compileall`, an isolated native App Server end-to-end import, and a clean dedup rerun passed.
- Codex Security diff scan covered 4/4 surfaces with 0 reportable findings.

## Compatibility notes

- Moved workspaces are blocked because upstream currently treats the embedded Claude `cwd` as authoritative.
- Very large histories remain subject to upstream input limits.
- The external-agent migration API is experimental and was tested with Codex CLI 0.133.0.

See the [Claude import guide](https://github.com/AdamSkutt/codex-linux-repo-import/blob/main/docs/CLAUDE-IMPORT.md) for the complete safety and recovery contract.
